# Paper Information Matrix (the circles page)

David called it "a masterpiece" (2026-09-26). It is the house visual language for all reports:
- a 12-number headline strip;
- one band per statistic family, one circle per statistic;
- colour = needs work -> strong (red / grey / blue);
- size = distance from the norm;
- inner glyph = computed / AI-judged / runs disagree;
- dashed = no benchmark;
- a toggle between corpus and academic norms;
- a family map, 15 specialized charts, and a searchable wall of every statistic.
